newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell remaining stake in Escelsa.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell remaining stake in Escelsa.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it will sell the federal government's remaining stake in privatized Espirito Santo power firm Escelsa at an auction at 1330 local/1630 GMT Monday.
BNDES will offer 666,911 common shares or 14.65 percent of Escelsa's voting capital, belonging to federal power holding company Eletrobras, for a minimum price of 162 reais per share, the bank said.
Brazilian brokerages and banks Garantia, City Corretora de Cambio e Valores Mobiliarios, Primus and Bradesco are coordinating the sale, it added.
Privatized in 1995, Escelsa is controlled by a group of pension funds and Iven SA, a firm created by local and foreign investment banks and firms to invest in the Brazilian power sector.
The auction will be held on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
